d:
ISRO successfully launches the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket from Sriharikota. The 2,250-kg satellite is expected to restore NavIC to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites. With a mission life of 12 years, NVS-03 carries an indigenous atomic clock and adds the L1 signal to the navigation system. The launch marks the GSLV’s 20th mission and its shortest turnaround time of 56 days.
Thank you for watching our video!
